title: Electrolyte-Gated Graphene Field Effect Transistor-Based Ca 2+ Detection Aided by Machine Learning.
summary: Random-forest regression from graphene sensor transfer curves predicted spiked Ca²⁺ concentrations; on a 3,600-row test split, error was within one log unit for 95.11% of predictions and four sensor curves tracked nominal concentrations with Pearson r>0.999. This is a standard-solution proof of concept.
ai_technology: Methods §2.5 and Results §§3.4–3.5: regressors map sensor bias/transfer curves to log Ca²⁺ concentration.
